# Feral Cat — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots run).** Endgame build (level 60), 11/35/5 — respec at levels 30 and 60. The decision loop walks 96 rules in ascending priority and executes the first whose condition is true. The party fixtures place this spec on level 38 (2 members), level 48 (1 member), level 51 (2 members), level 60 (12 members). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/druid/feral-cat/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

**Measured in round 155** (amp-6's per-spec table). **GOOD** — 111% of the human spec median (424 vs 380.8 boss DPS over 71 boss fights) (+105 median vs r154, same gear) [measured].

**This page is the bots' half.** It records what our party bots actually run for this spec — the level-60 build and the level-by-level order, the rule firing order the decision loop walks, the kit bands, the round-155 measurement and the recorded deviations. The hand-written guide for this spec is [feral-cat.md](./feral-cat.md).

## How the bots play it

On every decision tick the loop walks the rules in ascending `priority`, executes the first one whose condition is true and skips the rest of that tick. The groups below are a reading aid; the priority numbers are the real order. Level is the rule's own `level_min` — the first level it can fire.

## Situational notes from the rule notes

Every sentence below is copied from a rule's own note (the rule id is in front of it) and mentions a situation the rule exists for. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here; their items are in the band table above.

- **DC00v-leave-cat-for-mark — cancel form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-343 (v43 party rules, orchestrator order 2026-10-18): the Cat leaves its form when ANY living member in heal range and sight lacks Mark of the Wild or Gift of the Wild (party.any_missing(1126), v43, the druid included; the Mark rule DC00w lends covered_by 21849), not only when the druid itself lacks it (the old test, OQ-2850 and the member-lacking half HO-TKB-PLAY-161 left waiting). Same 60 percent floor on self.form_mana_pct as before (the druid's own mana, read while shapeshifted, not rage or energy).
- **DC00w-mark-of-the-wild — Mark of the Wild:** HO-TKB-PLAY-161: also not in Aquatic Form (1066) or Travel Form (783): all 48 failed Mark pushes of one cat druid in d-20261010T063000Z were SPELL_FAILED_NOT_SHAPESHIFT with Aquatic Form up while it swam. HO-TKB-PLAY-129 (p4-pioneer decision 189 (d), rotation gaps for track 1 at level 22: a party whose only druid is feral got no Mark of the Wild): the restoration file's DS01 (party_missing, out of combat, not while drinking or eating), in caster form only, so it never takes the druid out of a form.
- **DC00x-thorns-tank — Thorns:** HO-TKB-PLAY-161: also not in Aquatic Form (1066) or Travel Form (783): all 48 failed Mark pushes of one cat druid in d-20261010T063000Z were SPELL_FAILED_NOT_SHAPESHIFT with Aquatic Form up while it swam. HO-TKB-PLAY-129: the restoration file's DS02 (Thorns on the party tank, the resident when it tanks) in caster form only, as the Mark above.
- **DC00y-thorns-self — Thorns:** HO-TKB-PLAY-161: also not in Aquatic Form (1066) or Travel Form (783): all 48 failed Mark pushes of one cat druid in d-20261010T063000Z were SPELL_FAILED_NOT_SHAPESHIFT with Aquatic Form up while it swam. HO-TKB-PLAY-129: solo, Thorns on the druid itself (DS02b), in caster form only.
- **DC00u-consecrated-stone — Apply Consecrated Sharpening Stone:** Source (p4-pioneer source check; buy price 160 copper is a price, not a source): weak: 8 quest rewards (undead stone). "Weapon: Consecrated (Undead) > Elemental Sharpening Stone" (L231, L218): +100 attack power against undead for an hour (spell 28891), so only with an undead (creature type 6) targeted out of combat; DC00u-elemental-stone waits while it is on.
- **DC00u-demonslaying — Use Elixir of Demonslaying:** HO-TKB-PLAY-341 (druid and shaman consumables, orchestrator ruling 2026-10-18: every page-recommended consumable a pioneer can realistically get (crafted with a found recipe, a quest reward, or sold) gets a use rule, so the kit generator carries it): Item 9224 Elixir of Demonslaying, required level 40, buff spell 11406. "Demons: Elixir of Demonslaying" (L234): +264 attack power against demons (spell 11406 aura 102), so only out of combat with a hostile demon (creature type 3) targeted.
- **DC00u-mighty-rage — Use Mighty Rage Potion:** "Potion: Mighty Rage > Quickness" (L232); class mask 1025 (warrior and druid); drunk on a boss pull (target.boss, the file's own test for Berserk), which is the page's raid use: the page names no pull rule (open question 2).
- **DC00u-elemental-stone — Apply Elemental Sharpening Stone:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Elemental Sharpening Stone (item 18262, required level 50), sharpening stone (enchant 22756, edged weapons only), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 218); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **DC00u-mongoose — Use Elixir of the Mongoose:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Elixir of the Mongoose (item 13452, required level 46), elixir or potion (aura 17538 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 227); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **DC00u-dumplings — Use Smoked Desert Dumplings:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Smoked Desert Dumplings (item 20452, required level 45), buff food (the food's buff aura 24799), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 230); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **DC00u-giants — Use Elixir of Giants:** HO-TKB-PLAY-341 (druid and shaman consumables, orchestrator ruling 2026-10-18: every page-recommended consumable a pioneer can realistically get (crafted with a found recipe, a quest reward, or sold) gets a use rule, so the kit generator carries it): Item 9206 Elixir of Giants, required level 38, buff spell 11405. "Strength: Juju Power > Elixir of Giants" (feral-cat.md L226): not while Juju Power (16323) is up, since the two are the same Strength buff.
- **DC00q-aquatic-form — Aquatic Form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-140 (owner, 2026-10-08: druids use Aquatic Form for their own swims; the party buff is the shaman's or warlock's (HO-TKB-PLAY-139)): in water and out of combat, Aquatic Form (1066, quest at 16, instant): it breathes underwater and swims faster, so the druid needs no breath buff (p4-group's swim hold counts a druid as covered). self.swimming is the map's liquid at the resident (v28).
- **DC05g-leave-cat-moon — cancel form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-123 (vocabulary v25, p1-loop HO-P1-LOOP-034: a cancel_form rule may carry a selector and its `when` reads that view): the step out of Cat Form for DC05h-hibernate-moon. When this druid owns the Moon mark (p4-group 296) and the mark is a beast or dragonkin that DC05h would Hibernate (the same two branches: no Hibernate and two engaged, or one if the mark has no victim yet; again only under 3 s left), leave Cat; the 029 stance hold gives DC05h the form-free decisions, then DC01-cat-form puts Cat back.
- **DC05h-hibernate-moon — Hibernate:** HO-TKB-PLAY-120 (owner-approved, TortoiseBots review LEARN 1: crowd control on the party's CC mark): Hibernate on the Moon-marked mob when it is a beast or a dragonkin (targetCreatureType 3, `target.creature_type(1)` or `(2)`); 90 mana at rank 1, 1.5 s, 30 yd; ranks 2637, 18657, 18658; damage breaks it. The guide: "Hibernate a Beast add (Beasts and Dragonkin only)" and at Black Morass "Hibernate one mob in each 3- and 4-mob pack" (guide/classes/druid/leveling.md L134, L234). p4-group 296 makes this druid the mark's only owner (never the tank or healer).
- **DC01-cat-form — Cat Form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-300 (leveller rotation pass, owner order 2026-10-18): Dire Bear Form (9634) replaces Bear Form (5487) at level 40: every druid of 40 or more on the realm knows 9634 and none knows 5487 (35 of 35), and 9634 has no spell_chain row, so the form tests and the form-cast rules that named only 5487 were dead from 40 on (the Bear Form pack and panic rules, Maul, Swipe, Bash, Enrage and Demoralizing Roar in the cat file). The guide keeps Bear for packs and tanking in the 40s in Dire Bear Form (leveling.md L162, L206).
- **DC02a-dire-bear-form-leveling — Dire Bear Form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-300 (leveller rotation pass, owner order 2026-10-18): the Dire Bear Form twin of DC02a-bear-form-leveling from level 40: the same condition, the form the druid actually has from 40 (Bear Form is replaced by Dire Bear Form: no druid of 40 or more knows 5487). Bear Form is castable from Cat Form and Dire Bear Form from any form (stances 0).
- **DC01a-prowl — Prowl:** HO-TKB-PLAY-027 (decision 86, OQ-1807): Prowl 5215 (spellLevel 20, Cat Form stance) so that Ravage and Pounce have a stealth to open from; the archive opens "Prowl -> Tiger's Fury -> Pounce -> Rake -> Rip -> Claw to 5 -> Ferocious Bite". The guards are the rogue's Stealth rule's (RC01): out of combat, something within 30 yards, alone.
- **DC15p-leave-bear-to-pull — cancel form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-300 (leveller rotation pass, owner order 2026-10-18): Dire Bear Form form-test parity (see DC04a, same change). HO-TKB-PLAY-076 (orchestrator, solo audit of levels 10-20; HELD for a measured round): the guide's Bear levels pull "from range with Moonfire, then shift to Bear Form before the mob arrives" (druid/leveling.md L119); the solo druid was a bear between fights and cast Moonfire twice in ten hours.
- **DC15k-leave-bear-to-heal — cancel form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-300 (leveller rotation pass, owner order 2026-10-18): Dire Bear Form form-test parity (see DC04a, same change). Out of combat under 50 per cent health with a pool of 40 mana: leave Bear Form; DC15r-rejuvenation-self casts.
- **DC02a-bear-form-leveling — Bear Form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-140 (P1L39-C1): not while swimming: Aquatic Form holds in water, and on land or in combat the loop's stance push shifts back. HO-TKB-PLAY-042 (decision 118: Bear Form, Maul, Growl and the rest of the level-10 quest are now GRANTED): this file had Bear Form only as a threat blip at under 70 per cent health (DC04a) and NO damage rule in the form, so a feral druid of level 10 to 19 that took the form once stood in it for ever with auto-attack alone (no rule can cancel a form, and the caster rules are false while it stands).
- **DC15r-rejuvenation-self — Rejuvenation:** HO-TKB-PLAY-300 (leveller rotation pass, owner order 2026-10-18): Dire Bear Form form-test parity (see DC04a, same change). HO-TKB-PLAY-076: the self heal between pulls (druid/leveling.md L123), cast in caster form after DC15k left the bear; 25 mana at rank 1, 40 at rank 2 (spell 1058).
- **DC02-berserk — Berserk:** HO-TKB-PLAY-241 (PIONEER FIX, tkb-play endgame specs programme, owner order 2026-10-18): at level 60 Berserk (6-minute cooldown, DB 360000) is kept for boss rows: "too long to use on every boss; save it for the long bleedable bosses" (guide L146).
- **DC04cc-bash-bear-caster — Bash:** HO-TKB-PLAY-300 (leveller rotation pass, owner order 2026-10-18): Dire Bear Form form-test parity (see DC04a, same change). HO-TKB-PLAY-042 (decision 118: Bear Form, Maul, Growl and the rest of the level-10 quest are now GRANTED): this file had Bear Form only as a threat blip at under 70 per cent health (DC04a) and NO damage rule in the form, so a feral druid of level 10 to 19 that took the form once stood in it for ever with auto-attack alone (no rule can cancel a form, and the caster rules are false while it stands).
- **DC03a-ravage — Ravage:** Ravage 6785 is spellLevel 32, 60 energy, Cat Form, behind-only at the pin (AttributesEx2 0x100000 and AttributesEx 0x200). A grouped druid is refused Prowl as a rogue is refused Stealth (CastRefusal clause 1 tests the stealth aura, which Prowl carries) and this rule is solo-only, so the openers below are true only while levelling alone: no effect in a dungeon party.
- **DC03b-pounce — Pounce:** Pounce 9005 is spellLevel 36, 50 energy, Cat Form, and behind-only at the pin (AttributesEx2 0x100000 and AttributesEx 0x200; the flag check is the same one, so it is refused from the front as Shred is). A grouped druid is refused Prowl as a rogue is refused Stealth (CastRefusal clause 1 tests the stealth aura, which Prowl carries) and this rule is solo-only, so the openers below are true only while levelling alone: no effect in a dungeon party.

HO-TKB-PLAY-042 (decision 118: Bear Form, Maul, Growl and the rest of the level-10 quest are now GRANTED): this file had Bear Form only as a threat blip at under 70 per cent health (DC04a) and NO damage rule in the form, so a feral druid of level 10 to 19 that took the form once stood in it for ever with auto-attack alone (no rule can cancel a form, and the caster rules are false while it stands).

Bear Form is castable from Cat Form and Dire Bear Form from any form (stances 0).
- **DC04-barkskin-feral — Barkskin (Feral):** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **DC15c-leave-bear-low-and-safe — cancel form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-300 (leveller rotation pass, owner order 2026-10-18): Dire Bear Form form-test parity (see DC04a, same change). HO-TKB-PLAY-076 (orchestrator: Healing Touch out of form when low and safe): in combat, under 35 per cent health, one hostile within 8 yd, the target above 30 per cent (a nearly dead mob is finished, not fled), a pool of 60 mana: leave Bear Form, DC15h casts Healing Touch.
- **DC15h-healing-touch-self — Healing Touch:** HO-TKB-PLAY-300 (leveller rotation pass, owner order 2026-10-18): Dire Bear Form form-test parity (see DC04a, same change). No substitute: Faerie Fire (Feral) 16857 is the only feral-form version and it has no lower rank; the caster-form Faerie Fire 770 is stances-excluded from Cat Form, which is decision 47s whole point.
- **DC09a-bite-carnage — Ferocious Bite:** HO-TKB-PLAY-241 (PIONEER FIX, tkb-play endgame specs programme, owner order 2026-10-18): Ferocious Bite at 5 combo points while Rip is up (Carnage refreshes Rip and Rake), never below 5 on a boss (guide L98, L272); above Rake (L99).
- **DC10-rake — Rake:** The cheaper of the two builders and the one that leaves something behind, so it takes the tick whenever its aura is down.
- **DC09-ferocious-bite — Ferocious Bite:** 35 energy, direct damage, no duration to lose, so it is gated on the target being nearly dead rather than on an aura -- the same shape as Eviscerate in the three rogue files.
- **DC11a-shred — Shred:** Shred 5221 is spellLevel 22, 60 energy, Cat Form, behind-only at the pin (AttributesEx2 0x100000 and AttributesEx 0x200), refused SPELL_FAILED_NOT_BEHIND from the front.
- **DC16-reshift-cat — Reshift:** HO-TKB-PLAY-241 (PIONEER FIX, tkb-play endgame specs programme, owner order 2026-10-18): Reshift (cancel and reapply Cat Form, core spell_druid_reshift) when energy is under 28 and Tiger's Fury is gone or about to expire; Furor 5/5 refunds 40 energy, Tiger's Fury is then recast by DC03 (Reshift drops it, guide L107). Form cost is 35 percent of mana (DB), so it needs 50 percent form mana.
- **DC04g-maul-bear — Maul:** HO-TKB-PLAY-300 (leveller rotation pass, owner order 2026-10-18): Dire Bear Form form-test parity (see DC04a, same change). HO-TKB-PLAY-042 (decision 118: Bear Form, Maul, Growl and the rest of the level-10 quest are now GRANTED): this file had Bear Form only as a threat blip at under 70 per cent health (DC04a) and NO damage rule in the form, so a feral druid of level 10 to 19 that took the form once stood in it for ever with auto-attack alone (no rule can cancel a form, and the caster rules are false while it stands).
- **DC05a-entangling-roots-second — Entangling Roots:** The runtime backs a spell off after two pushes in a row that leave no aura on the target (p1-loop v12, ineffective_backoff for 10 s on that guid), so a creature that shrugs it off costs two casts, not a fight.
- **DC11d-moonfire — Moonfire:** HO-TKB-PLAY-030 (orchestrator: levels 1-10 before the forms): Moonfire rank 1 (8921, trainer at level 4, 25 mana) once per mob, the archive's caster phase: "From level 4, cast Moonfire once per mob" and then Wrath. Same guards as the Wrath rule beside it: in no form (Cat 768, Bear 5487, Dire Bear 9634), standing, and not while the target already carries it.
- **DC11c-wrath — Wrath:** HO-TKB-PLAY-030 (p3-runtime, the level-1 window): this file had no ability rule below the form level, so a feral druid of level 1-20 fought on auto-attack alone. Guarded out of every form (Cat 768, Bear 5487, Dire Bear 9634: a form cannot cast it) and below the approach rule, which is the staff melee once the mana is gone.

## What the bots do not do (from the rule notes)

Sentences from the rules' notes that say what is deliberately not implemented, or that name an open question.

- **DC00u-mighty-rage:** "Potion: Mighty Rage > Quickness" (L232); class mask 1025 (warrior and druid); drunk on a boss pull (target.boss, the file's own test for Berserk), which is the page's raid use: the page names no pull rule (open question 2).
- **DC09-ferocious-bite:** "Finishes the mob" is target.hp_pct <= 20 (the guide gives no number: open question).
